about: Waits the method's wording cannot settle on its own, each reviewed by a person. min and max are the unattended minutes the recipe takes beyond prep and cook. src/lib/timing.js uses these in place of what it reads from the method; tools/timing-audit.js lists them.

brisket.reason: "Close the lid and leave it alone for 3 hours" is smoking time, already in the cook time; the wait counted is the rest of at least 2 hours (ideally 4, not counted as the ceiling because the method treats it as an ideal). The hour the seasoned brisket sits at room temperature before smoking is not counted; whether the prep time allows for it is open for review.

lasagna-bolognese.reason: "Rest for at least 20 minutes before cutting" is required (the method says the lasagne will not hold a slice otherwise) but falls under the reader's 30-minute floor for counting a wait. Cooking is the ragù chain in sequence (4 + 12 + 10 + 5 + 20 minutes, then a 2.5 to 3 hour simmer) plus 40 minutes' baking: 241 to 271 minutes in the row and cookMax. The besciamella and oven heating overlap the simmer and are not added; chopping and assembly are in the 45 minutes of prep.

naengmyeon.reason: The waits run one after another: soaking the beef 1 hour, pressing it under a weight for an hour, chilling the broth at least 6 hours and freezing it 90 minutes until slushy. The reader skips the chill-and-freeze sentence because "freezer" usually marks a storage note, and pressing has no waiting verb. Cooking is the 2-hour simmer plus 2 to 3 minutes for the noodles (122 to 123 in the row and cookMax). The beef can be pressed while the broth chills, which would shorten the total by an hour; the figure assumes the order the method gives.

pastitsio.reason: "Rest 30 minutes before cutting — this is essential" is required, but a single 30-minute wait falls under the reader 60-minute floor for counting. Cooking is the meat sauce in sequence (10 + 1 + 10 minutes, the wine bubbling off, then 45 minutes simmering) and 50 to 55 minutes baking: 116 to 121 minutes. The pasta and the béchamel are made while the sauce simmers and are not added.

freezer-lasagna.reason: The reader took the 1 hour 15 minute bake from frozen ("Bake from frozen, covered, for 1 hour 15 minutes") as a freezing wait. Freezing is the optional make-ahead route; baked fresh there is no required wait. Cooking on the fresh route is browning in two batches (8 minutes each), 6 minutes for the vegetables, the 30-minute simmer and 45 minutes baking: about 99 minutes. The 15-minute rest is under the floor and sits in the preparation time.

chili-con-carne.reason: "Rest for 20 minutes before serving — or better, cool and refrigerate overnight": the overnight chill is offered as an improvement after a dash, which the reader does not split off as an alternative, so it was counted as a required 8 hours. The required wait is the 20-minute rest. Cooking is browning in three batches (about 5 minutes each), 8 + 4 minutes for the onions and peppers, 90 seconds for the spices, 2 minutes for the purée, 2 hours in the oven and 30 minutes with the beans: 181 minutes.

sourdough-bread.reason: The bulk ferment is given as "typically 5 to 7 hours in total", counted from when the starter goes in, so the 30-minute rest after adding it and the four coil folds over 3 hours run inside it and are not added again. Waits: autolyse 1 hour, bulk 5 to 7 hours, pre-shape rest 25 minutes, cold retard 12 to 16 hours, cooling at least 2 hours: 1225 to 1585 minutes. The bulk time depends on dough temperature and starter strength; the method gives the readiness cue (risen by about 60%, airy, bubbles on the surface).

cheese-herb-quick-bread.reason: Method requires5minutes in the tin followed by at least10on a rack:15unattended minutes beyond prep15/cook50. Both short waits fall below the generic parser15minute cutoff. Source https://www.recipetineats.com/cheese-herb-garlic-quick-bread/ states80minutes total. This is source arithmetic, not kitchen-testing evidence.

chicken-cobbler.reason: Method requires a10minute rest after baking, beyond prep5and cooking48to53minutes (3steaming+45to50baking). Parser skips waits under15minutes. Count this wait rather than generating a53minute complete-time claim. Source https://www.spendwithpennies.com/chicken-cobbler-recipe/ states63minutes at the lower bake bound. Source reconciliation only; not cooking evidence.

chocolate-concrete.reason: Method requires5minutes in the tin before cutting, beyond prep10and baking30to35. Parser skips waits under15minutes. Count this supported wait; subsequent complete cooling remains explicitly untimed, so there is no complete totalTime claim. Source https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/chocolate-crunch . Source reconciliation only; not cooking evidence.
